clue.text: Person of mixed race wanting to feature in Cummings' copy

indicators.note: to feature in something is to appear inside it, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: the poet e. e. cummings signed with his initials, two letter Es

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the following word is taken away

parts.note: a dated term for a person of mixed race is a mulatto
taken as written, the word removed

explanation.surface: A request for a person of mixed heritage to appear in a copy of a work by Cummings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Person of mixed race' looks like the definition, but it is wordplay; the poet e. e. cummings wrote his name in lower case, so his initials supply the outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To emulate someone is to imitate them, which is a verb sense of copy.

clue.text: King hastened to interrupt revolutionary convert

indicators.note: something that interrupts breaks into the middle, so these letters go inside

parts.note: Mao Zedong led the Chinese communist revolution
R is short for rex, Latin for king
hastened means ran

explanation.surface: A monarch rushes to break in on a rebel who has changed sides.
explanation.definitionFit: A Marrano was a Jew in medieval Spain or Portugal who converted to Christianity, often only outwardly.

clue.text: Look up song that's true

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: a lay is a song or ballad

explanation.surface: Searching for a song that is genuine.
explanation.definitionFit: Loyal and true are synonyms, both meaning faithful.

clue.text: Proposition others about mineral source

indicators.note: about here means around, so the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: them can stand for other people, as in us and them
ore is rock from which minerals are extracted

explanation.surface: Someone proposes that other people be told about where minerals come from.
explanation.definitionFit: A theorem is a proposition in mathematics or logic that can be proved.

clue.text: One supplying backing, born to lend a hand

parts.note: b is the standard abbreviation for born, as in genealogies
to lend a hand is to assist

explanation.surface: A helper who supports others was born to be helpful.
explanation.definitionFit: A bass player provides the low backing line underneath a band's melody.

clue.text: Off course like platter

parts.note: as means like, in the sense of similar to
a platter is a large flat dish, a kind of tray

explanation.surface: Something gone off course is compared to a serving dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Astray means wandering from the correct path, the same as off course.

clue.text: Drunk skirting edges is a self-sufficient type

indicators.note: skirting means going round the outside, so the drunk wraps the rest

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard
lips are edges, as of a cup or a crater
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drunkard staggering along the edges of things is a type who needs nobody.
explanation.definitionFit: A solipsist believes only the self can be known to exist, a self-contained type taken to the extreme.

clue.text: Singular way to ramble

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
to range is to roam or ramble widely

explanation.surface: An unusual route to go walking.
explanation.definitionFit: Singular can mean odd or remarkable, the same as strange.

clue.text: Knot concealing yen to prepare to defend allotment

indicators.note: concealing means hiding inside, so the first piece wraps the others

parts.note: kn is the abbreviation for knot, a unit of speed
a yen is a longing, as is an itch
en garde is the fencer's call to take a defensive stance

explanation.surface: A tangle of rope hides a craving to get ready to guard a plot of land.
explanation.walkthrough: EN GARDE is the French call used in fencing, meaning 'on guard', so it fits 'prepare to defend'.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen garden is a plot for growing vegetables, and an allotment is a rented plot used for the same purpose.

clue.text: Wear for battle

definitions.meaning: to wear thin at the edges

explanation.definitionFit: Fray means both to wear through by rubbing and a noisy fight.

clue.text: Form of novel — early one with post involved

indicators.note: involved means tangled or intricate, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one
taken as written

explanation.surface: An early kind of novel, one that was sent by post.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is apt: early novels such as Richardson's Pamela were told in letters, and letters go by post.
explanation.definitionFit: An epistolary novel is one told through letters, a recognised form of the novel; the adjective names that form.

clue.text: One in store takes salt

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a silo is a store for grain
a means one, as in a single thing
R stands for recipe, Latin for take, written on prescriptions

explanation.surface: Someone in a shop buys some salt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A inside SILO, giving SAILO. R for 'takes' comes from the old prescription heading 'Rx', short for Latin recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: An old salt is a seasoned sailor, so salt alone is a crossword word for a sailor.

clue.text: Hugging serpent in embrace

indicators.note: in places the snake inside the other word

parts.note: to cling is to hold tightly, an embrace
an asp is a venomous snake

explanation.surface: A snake wrapped in someone's arms.
explanation.definitionFit: Clasping and hugging both mean holding something tightly in the arms.

clue.text: Outfitter supplying more comfort about the belly

indicators.note: about means around, so the first word goes round the second

parts.note: cosier means giving more comfort
tum is an informal word for the belly

explanation.surface: A tailor offering extra comfort around the stomach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'more comfort' is loose for 'more comfy', but the comparative adjective is what the wordplay needs.
explanation.definitionFit: A costumier makes or supplies costumes, a kind of outfitter.

clue.text: Tense third-generation Scot holding record for redundancy

parts.note: taut means tense or tight

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: oy is a Scots word for a grandchild
a log is a record, as a ship's log

explanation.surface: An anxious grandchild in Scotland keeps a record of job losses.
explanation.walkthrough: In Scots dialect a grandchild is an oy or oe, the third generation counting from the grandparent.
explanation.definitionFit: Tautology is needless repetition of an idea, which is redundancy in language.

clue.text: Foxy lady's early night starts after 5 to 9

indicators.note: after puts the first letters behind the numerals

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
IX is the Roman numeral for nine

indicators.note: starts means the first letters of the words given

explanation.surface: An attractive woman's evening out starts after a day of work from five to nine.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests office hours, but the numbers become Roman numerals V and IX.
explanation.definitionFit: A vixen is a female fox, so a foxy lady taken literally.

clue.text: Hold forth, getting odds miscalculated

parts.note: SP stands for starting price, the odds at the start of a race
out means wrong, as in a calculation being out

explanation.surface: Someone lecturing at length because the betting odds were reckoned wrongly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'miscalculated' looks like an anagram signal, but it simply means OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: To spout is to talk at length in a pompous way, the same as holding forth.

clue.text: Lead many into deeper trouble

indicators.note: into places the letter inside the other piece
trouble means disturb, so the letters are stirred up

parts.note: taken as written
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many

explanation.surface: Leading a crowd into worse difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' rearranges DEEPER to PREEDE, and 'into' puts C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To precede is to go before, which is to lead.

clue.text: Plant, say, with worker among the ancestry

parts.note: eg means for example, so say

indicators.note: among places the worker inside the other word

parts.note: line means lineage or ancestry
a worker ant is the stock crossword worker

explanation.surface: A factory hand works among ancestral plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Eglantine is the sweetbriar, a wild rose, so a plant.

clue.text: Umpire arranged to eat snack

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so the first piece wraps the second

parts.note: arr. is the abbreviation for arranged, as on a music score
a bite is a snack

explanation.surface: A referee organises a time to have a quick meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' looks like an anagram signal, but it is ARR, the music abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter is someone who settles disputes, as an umpire does.

clue.text: Virtually redundant indicators

indicators.note: virtually means almost, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: needless means unnecessary, so redundant

explanation.surface: Signals that are almost unnecessary.
explanation.definitionFit: Needles are pointers on dials and gauges, so indicators.

clue.text: Article left beneath left entrance

indicators.note: in a down clue, beneath means these letters come below the other

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
a is the indefinite article
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A thing left below something left over.
explanation.definitionFit: A portal is an imposing doorway, an entrance.

clue.text: Time to launch attack on spillage of Ruhr ooze

indicators.note: spillage means the letters are spilt out and reassembled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An attack set off by sludge leaking in the Ruhr valley.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ruhr is a German industrial region, a target in war, which adds to the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Zero hour is the time set for a military operation to begin.

clue.text: Some grain on the scrubland railway

parts.note: the bush is wild scrubland
el is the American word for an elevated railway

explanation.surface: Some grain is carried by the railway across the scrub.
explanation.definitionFit: A bushel is a measure of volume used for grain, so a quantity of it.

clue.text: Extort from S8

parts.note: S followed by 8, a rowing eight, which is a crew

explanation.surface: Squeezing money out of something with a code name.
explanation.walkthrough: A rowing eight is the crew of an eight-oared boat, so S8 reads S + CREW.
explanation.definitionFit: To screw money out of someone is to extort it.

clue.text: Drive crazy, drinking wine in carriage

indicators.note: drinking means taking in, so the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: to dement is to drive mad
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Being driven mad while drinking wine in a horse-drawn carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Deportment is the way one carries oneself, also called carriage or bearing.

clue.text: List percussion effect

definitions.meaning: a list of names, as a register
a drum ... is a rapid series of beats

explanation.definitionFit: Roll means both an official list of names and a sustained drumming sound.

clue.text: Do something different with cold celery

definitions.text: Do something different with cold celery

indicators.note: doing something different with letters means rearranging them

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
taken as written

explanation.surface: Advice to reuse leftover cold celery in a new dish.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: rearranging C and CELERY is itself doing something different with them.
explanation.definitionFit: To recycle is to process used material so it can serve again, doing something new with it.

clue.text: Daring to put ship's front and plane's tail on ship

parts.note: the prow is the front of a ship

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its last letter

parts.note: SS is short for steamship

explanation.surface: A bold move to fit a ship's bow and an aircraft's tail onto a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Prowess means great skill or daring in battle.
